text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ngh… I sure hate t'be all mopey in front of you…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But I tried so hard t'day—really gave it my all! And yet…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I let everyone who was cheer'n for me down…
choice_data_list: If that's how you feel, then you've got what it takes to get stronger.
You giving up is the last thing anyone wants to see.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I swear, when I fall apart, you're always the one pick'n up the pieces… But that does make me feel better!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I know you'd never lie t'me, so that means I really can get stronger!
choice_data_list: Yep, as long as we both work hard.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's do it! Next time's gonna be diff'rent—we'll be celebrat'n a win!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You know, I think that's it… My sav'n grace is not know'n when to call it quits!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, no use gett'n bent outta shape—I gotta stay flexible and roll with the punches!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'm gett'n that win. I'm finish'n in first place f'sure!
